Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.cacheHit())
```
